scope: Offline unit and controlled CDP/DOM/HTTP handler fixtures. No live TradingView session, real webhook delivery or listening HTTP socket was exercised.

tests.name: Initialize negotiates a supported protocol, tools list is machine-readable and ping works
Tool errors use isError, while JSON-RPC errors retain protocol codes
Plaintext secrets are redacted from successful results and result text remains JSON
UTF-8 newline stdio handles split multibyte messages and emits only protocol JSON
JSON-RPC batch and nonobject messages are rejected
Resource and prompt lookups reject inherited names and non-string identifiers
The complete delivered tool catalog is discoverable through MCP pagination without omissions
Cancellation aborts a running tool through its signal
Loopback HTTP requires a strong token and rejects wildcard binding
Actual HTTP handler enforces authentication, Origin, Host, path and method before MCP execution
CDP endpoint rejects remote hosts, DNS aliases, credentials, paths and redirect-shaped query
CDP websocket discovery cannot redirect to a remote host or unrelated local port
TradingView target origin must be exact HTTPS; public URLs remove unneeded secret query/fragment
Caller JavaScript and credential/storage accessors are prohibited
Page wrapper preserves hostile text as data and does not execute it
Page fetch blocks third-party, localhost, credentials and forbidden auth headers before network
Browser authentication stays implicit and no cookie canary reaches Node transport
CDP cookie/network/remote object methods are not in the callable allowlist
Redirects remain forbidden for allowed page fetch requests
Origin is checked again inside the live page after discovery
Webhook validation rejects local/private endpoints and does not send a test request
Known secrets are redacted in maps, free text, query parameters and provider key formats
MCP schemas reject prototype pollution and unknown arguments
Mutation cannot use a URL layout ID when native widget identity is absent
A changed native layout blocks the write and log contains no input body
A logging failure preserves a completed action receipt instead of inviting duplicate retries
Owner-only exports stay confined and CSV formula cells are escaped
Storage refuses symlinked export directories
Internal storage area names cannot traverse or address an absolute sibling directory
Quoted JSON and source-like secret fields are redacted without breaking JSON
Cookie-export name/value records redact credential values recursively
Browser launcher inherits platform settings and excludes unrelated secrets and injection flags
Launcher refuses missing, duplicate or unknown options before choosing a profile
Session diagnostics and layout metadata discard arbitrary URL query secrets and fragments
CSV exports neutralize whitespace-prefixed and numeric-looking formulas and headers
Chrome discovery is bounded while streaming and cancels oversized bodies
New-target discovery refuses a non-TradingView response and sanitizes accepted URLs
A debugger that closes before opening rejects promptly and clears its state
